newsitem.title: USA: Imgram Micro IPO indication at $25-$28 - NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Imgram Micro IPO indication at $25-$28 - NYSE.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Ingram Micro Inc was indicated to open Friday at a price in the range of $25 to $28, well above the $18 price at which the widely ancipated initial public offering was priced Thursday.
The stock opened at 23-1/2, up 5-1/2 from its initial offer price, but then began to decline. It was trading at 20-3/4, at 1008 EST/1508 GMT.

Analysts consider Ingram Micro, the world's largest distributor of computer hardware, software and networking equipment, to be one of the higher quality technology stock offerings to come to market in 1996.
